notes.title: UPDATE #5
notes.notes:
Super small bug fix update that fixes the problem that some players where having when dragon would become unresponsive after getting stuck & after performing a force quit.

Thanks to the users who pointed it out to us! We do try to catch all bugs before launch, but some do slip past us! :) 

Thanks again everyone!

notes.title: Island Saver UPDATE #4 & New DLC
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

Thanks for all the positive messages/reviews of Island Saver - the team really appreciate it.

We have just released a game update that includes a new DLC - Fantasy Island.

The main game has also been updated to take onboard a number of bugs and suggestions from the community.

Changes include (among other things):

[list]
[*] You can now reset a single island's progress. Do this from the General Options menu when playing the island you want to reset
[*] 
[*] The last bits of gloop are now highlighted to make them easier to spot
[*] 
[*] Kiwi's reminders can be reduced (if you find them too frequent) - do this in the Options menu
[*] 
[*] Lots of little bug fixes to make the game more enjoyable for everyone.
[/list]

Thanks again to the community for the support and feedback - we are a small team making a multi-platform, so can't fix everything, but we do appreciate the community taking the time to interact with us.

We hope you enjoy the new DLC. Revenue from the DLC goes to support two charities: YoungMoney who focus on real-world financial education for children, and Special Effect, a charity that helps less able-bodied gamers with adaptive equipment so they can continue to enjoy  playing video games.

Thanks!

notes.title: Island Saver UPDATE #3
notes.notes:
Hello Bionauts!

Thanks to everyone for continuing to play and enjoy Island Saver.

We've just published a small update to allow the player to remap the keyboard better. Players can now remap to the Arrow Keys, and other keys that were previously reserved/allocated to specific functions in-game.

Hopefully this makes the game more accessible for all.

To allow this update there are some minor side-effects for exisiting players
[olist]
[*] Summoned bankimal selection is no longer hard-coded to keys 1 & 2, instead it is now set to be whatever keys players have mapped to Left/Right

[*] The arrow keys can no longer be used to navigate menus be default. However, whatever keys you have set up as your movement keys, should now naviagte the menus.
[/olist]
The dev team felt these minor side-effects were acceptable in order to open up the remapping more.

Thanks again to all players!

Best

Team Stormcloud

notes.title: Island Saver UPDATE #2
notes.notes:
Hello again Bionauts!

Thanks to everyone for playing Island Saver and for your feedback and positive reviews.

The development team really appreciate it!

We have released a new update to address the following issues:[list]
[*] Polar Bear not being able to walk up ice slopes (Fixed)
[*] Resolution Option only offering “low-res” options (Fixed)
[/list]
Thanks again to everyone for your feedback.

We are a small dev team and are managing this game across multiple platforms so thank you for your continued patience.

We will continue to address issues in future updates.

Stormcloud Team

notes.title: Island Saver UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello Bionauts! 

Thanks for all the feedback on Island Saver, and bug reporting.

We have launched an update that will fix the following issues:
[list]
[*] Blocker Bug: Golden Gate open but cannot go through due to invisible collision [FIXED]
[*] Blocker Bug: Unsaved hippo stuck up tree in Wallow Hole Way[FIXED]
[*] Blocker Bug: Locked in "Buy Rhino Seeds" loop in Rhino Rock. [FIXED] (Note: this fix does require players to delete save game and start a fresh game)
[*] Added: Mouse Sensitivity option to Settings
[*] Added: Invert Y to controls
[/list]

Thanks again for all the feedback, we are working on a 2nd DLC and will take on-board the suggestions made for other fixes/features in future updates.

Thanks!

Stormcloud Team!
